interaction: Pick a day (Mon–Sun) of the sample forecast or drag the swell dial: animated canvas waves change height and period, a surfer rides them (or the board is left on the sand), and the widget recommends Beginner-friendly, Intermediate or Stay on the sand with wind and tide icons, highlighting the matching lesson boards; the booking ticket updates an illustrative total live.
notes: Forecast data is a fixed sample week (clearly labelled), not live. Reduced motion draws a static wave that still updates height. Packing list ticks aren't saved. Booking ends in an on-page DEMO stamp and toast; nothing is sent or charged.
